title: GTA6 Official Album 'GTA VI The Album' Leaks With November 19 Release Date (Unconfirmed)
description: A leak on Reddit suggests Grand Theft Auto VI: The Album features 34 original tracks and sets a November 19 release. Read the details here.

content:
## GTA6 Official Album 'GTA VI The Album' Leaks With November 19 Release Date (Unconfirmed)

Recent discussions on the Reddit r/GTA6 community have brought forward a major music-related leak concerning *Grand Theft Auto VI*. Shared by community user /u/PapaXan, details regarding a compilation titled **Grand Theft Auto VI: The Album** have surfaced online, sparking widespread discussion among fans.

It is important to note that since this information originates from a community source, it remains an unconfirmed rumor until an official announcement is made by the publisher or developers.

### 34 Brand-New Original Tracks and Genre-Defying Roster

According to the shared details, *Grand Theft Auto VI: The Album* is set to feature a collection of **34 brand-new, original tracks**. The music compilation reportedly brings together a genre-defying roster of some of the most exciting and prominent music artists in the world today.

Music has always been a cornerstone of the *Grand Theft Auto* franchise, helping to define the cultural atmosphere and immersive nature of its open worlds. A dedicated, massive album of original music would align with the series' legacy of groundbreaking soundtracks.

### Six Debut Singles Available Today

The leak also highlights that **six debut singles** are already available for listeners to check out, featuring an impressive lineup of artists and producers:

* **Yung Lean - That's It** (feat. Future & Metro Boomin)
* **Travis Scott - RHYNO** (prod. by Guy-Manuel de Homem-Christo)
* **CA7RIEL & Paco Amoroso, PinkPantheress, Fred again.. & Etienne de Crécy** - Sexy Magic
* **Morgan Wallen** - Last Thing You Need
* **Rauw Alejandro** - Macacoa 2000
* **Keith Richards** - Bright Lights, Big City

### Release Date and Pre-Save Information

In terms of availability, the album is listed with a launch date of **November 19th**. Fans interested in tracking the release can already pre-save the album across all major music streaming services.

### Editor's Take

Music is the beating heart of the *Grand Theft Auto* experience. While this community-sourced leak should be taken with a grain of salt until officially verified, the star-studded lineup of artists attached to these tracks demonstrates the monumental scale of audio production we can expect from the next chapter of the franchise.
